_doc: c07 (critic C #2b, #6): extra entry lead in seconds for single entries that measured late against the ensemble (measured lag in c05 minus 0.05 s), {track: {score onset qn: seconds}}, matched within 0.02 qn. Added to the family ENTRY_LEAD_S (or used alone when the family has none); total capped at 0.30 s, converted through the tempo map (caesuras included). An onset of 0 starts inside the pre-roll. c10 (A #1): Violin I solo 48 +0.13 s (moved from Violins I, which no longer plays there) and 60 +0.10 s (the soft solo entries took 0.3-0.6 s to reach body level on the section patch). c11 (C #2, C #4): Horn 3 204 +0.10 (the bar 61 Ab4 reached body - 6 dB at +0.34 s); Violin I solo 48 0.13 -> 0.20.
